anchor.quote: Unix permissions are a nine-bit string: three groups of three

claims.rationale: The rwx owner/group/other layout is a reproducible nine-bit Unix fact; the listed octal examples are correct, and removing this arithmetic would collapse the post's permission grammar.

legacy.quote: "Unix permissions are a nine-bit string: three groups of three"
legacy.note: Numerically correct (rwx triads = 9 bits). Anchor of the post's structural grammar; all instances verified correct: 644 (L51, L63), 700 (L55, L103), 600 (L61), 777/000 (L73), rwxr-xr-x = 755 (L99). Remove the bit grammar and the post collapses.
